candidates.content_text:
ABOUT US
Ertech is a proudly employee-owned Australian civil and electrical construction company, delivering high-quality services across the Transport, Infrastructure, Resources, and Defence sectors. We partner with clients in both the public and private sectors, including state and federal governments. Since our humble beginnings in 1981, we’ve built a strong reputation for the quality of our work and the long-term relationships we foster — all driven by our core values of collaboration, courage, and authenticity.
 ABOUT THE ROLE
We are currently seeking an experienced Project Engineer (Civil) to join our Resources team, supporting the delivery of Civil and Electrical construction scopes on the Wheatstone NRU Thermal Oxidiser (TOX) Project.
As the Project Engineer, you will play a key role in the successful delivery of civil construction activities, providing technical and project support while ensuring works are delivered safely, efficiently and in line with project requirements, schedule and budget.
Other key responsibilities include, but not limited to:
- Coordinate daily construction activities to achieve project scope, schedule and budget requirements.
- Develop and monitor construction programs, key milestones, productivity and critical path activities.
- Review drawings, specifications and technical documentation to ensure works meet project and design requirements.
- Prepare methodologies, ITPs, SWMS and other engineering documentation.
- Manage RFIs, design clarifications and technical queries with relevant stakeholders.
- Forecast labour, plant, materials and subcontractor requirements.
- Identify project risks, constraints and potential delays, implementing mitigation and recovery strategies.
- Verify quantities, completed works and progress claims.
- Support project reporting, documentation and contractual deliverables.
To be successful, you will have experience and demonstrate capability in the following:
- Tertiary qualification in Civil Engineering.
- Minimum 5 years’ experience in civil construction project delivery.
- Experience delivering works within brownfield industrial or resources environments.
- Strong knowledge of concrete, foundations, earthworks and underground services.
- Experience in contract administration and commercial management.
- Proven ability to coordinate multiple work fronts and subcontractors.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Primavera P6 and project management systems.
- Construction White Card (CPCWHS1001 – Prepare to work safely in the construction industry).
- Ability to obtain a National Police Clearance.
- Valid Australian working rights.
WHY JOIN ERTECH?
- Competitive remuneration, including site uplift
- Choice of a 2:2 or 2:1 roster to suit your lifestyle
- Supportive, team-oriented culture where collaboration and respect are valued 
- Play a key role in shaping the growth and success of our projects
- Career development and progression opportunities, annual performance development plans.
- Access to great benefits, including: 
- Discounted Private Health Insurance (HBF & Medibank)
- Annual flu vaccinations 
- Novated leasing options through Paywise
- Service recognition and milestone rewards 
- Employee Referral Program incentives 
OUR CULTURE
At Ertech, our people are fundamental to our success. We're focused on creating an inclusive workplace, with the right people in the right roles, who are engaged, empowered, and appropriately rewarded. Ertech will provide you with the chance to be a part of great team, meet new people and gain experience with an industry leader who puts safety first. 
DIVERSITY & INCLUSION
We value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives of all people and actively encourage applications from First Nations peoples, all genders, culturally and linguistically diverse individuals, people with disability, LGBTQIA+ community members, and veterans of the Australian Defence Force.
Ertech is a proud Veteran Employment supporter. We recognise the valuable skills and leadership that veterans bring to our industry and welcome their applications at all levels of the business. Even if you don’t meet every requirement listed, we encourage you to apply and bring your strengths to our team.
HOW TO APPLY
Click "Apply" on this job advertisement, which will direct you to Ertech's application portal. Simply follow the steps outlined on the portal to complete your application.
This is an incredible opportunity! If you are looking for a position in an environment in which you can flourish whilst building your career, there is no better time to join the Ertech Team than now!
*Please note: This role is being sourced through Ertech directly and we will not accept applications via external recruitment agencies.

candidates.content_text:
Cascada is seeking an AutoCAD Drafter to join our team.
This is a great opportunity for a recent graduate or experienced drafter looking for a hands-on role in precast concrete and quality control.
Cascada Group manufactures and supplies a range of precast concrete products to the infrastructure, construction, and mining sectors, throughout Western Australia. Our clients include mining companies, engineers, construction companies, builders, plumbers, electricians, and architects.
The successful applicant will become a member of a supportive team with plenty of assistance and training in product knowledge and company processes.
The Role:
The draftsperson is responsible for producing high quality and accurate construction drawings, shop drawings and schematics. The successful applicant will create both 2D and 3D renderings of our extensive range of standard products as well as bespoke products designed to meet customer specifications.
Responsibilities:
- Primarily, you will create CAD drawings of precast concrete products for sales and production
- You will interpret customer supplied plans and develop the associated production drawings.
- Manage and control all drawings, associated documentation and project data
- Liaise with a wide range of people including managers, engineers, sales, and production staff.
- You will gain experience in manufacturing related activities particularly quality control.
- You will have the opportunity too work as a part of a fast paced team involved with significant civil and mining projects across the state.
Requirements:
- 1-2 years practical experience using AutoCAD
- Skilled at drawing quickly and accurately with an eye for detail.
- Experience with reinforcement detailing will be highly regarded.

About the Position
 The Engineering Technical Officer - Engineering Design provides civil engineering design, drafting, estimating, investigation and technical support for the City's capital and operational work programs. The position supports the Civil Design Coordinator in developing practical, compliant and constructible solutions for roads, drainage, parking, active transport, street scape and related infrastructure. Key responsibilities include:
- Preparing concept and detailed civil engineering designs, drawings, quantities and cost estimates.
- Coordinating survey, geotechnical investigation and other design input data and services.
- Undertaking site inspections, technical investigations and field surveys.
- Liaising with internal stakeholders, government agencies, service authorities, consultants, contractors and community stakeholders.
- Maintaining accurate engineering plans, records and asset information.
- Providing technical advice and guidance on traffic engineering, active transport, parking management and street lighting matters to internal and external stakeholders.
- Procurement tasks.
To be successful in this position you will need to demonstrate:
- Enrolment or completion of a Diploma in Civil Engineering or equivalent, or qualifications in AutoCAD Civil 3D with extensive design experience.
- Well developed verbal and written communication skills.
- Well developed computer literacy skills, including competency in Microsoft Office Suite.
- Well developed time management and problem-solving skills.
- Experience in the use of civil design packages such as AutoCAD and Civil 3D drafting software.
- Previous experience in road and drainage design in an urban environment.
- Current 'C' Class Driver's Licence.
- A current National Police Clearance.

About Us 
 Built on more than 40 years of industry leading experience. SCP Consulting is a privately owned, Australian engineering firm that provides high performance, multi-disciplinary engineering solutions for building and infrastructure projects. SCP is a diverse group that promotes a sustainable approach to design. 
 SCP Consulting is backed by Five Group, a national network of engineering, surveying, consulting, and professional services businesses. Through this connection, we benefit from shared expertise, strong operational support, and a collaborative network that strengthens our capability and creates opportunities for our people and clients across Australia and South-East Asia. 
Location: VIC 
 Our Benefits 
 - Genuine flexibility for work life balance 
 - Great team culture 
 - Employee assistance program 
 - Career development opportunities with SCP Consulting  
 - Ongoing rewards and recognition programs  
 Your Role 
 As Drafting Engineer, you’ll be required to product drawings and coordination thereof across Building Services disciplines, including Mechanical, Fire, Hydraulics and Electrical Services. You will have the chance to work on some exciting projects and the chance to work autonomously with our Engineers.   
 You’ll: 
 - Produce detailed drawings using Revit and AutoCAD 
 - Collaborate with engineering and project teams  
 - Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations  
 - Coordinate multi-discipline models and resolve clashes  
 - Document Management and Delivery  
 What You’ll Bring 
 - 5-6 years’ experience in a similar role  
 - Qualifications in drafting, construction design, engineering or equivalent  
 - Competent with Revit and AutoCAD 
 - Enthusiasm, attention to detail and willingness to contribute and learn 
 - Self-driven with Strong communication skills  
 WE ENCOURAGE YOU TO APPLY 
 We encourage you to apply and become part of a team where your contribution is valued and your career can grow. At Five Group, we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where people can thrive and succeed. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted as we progress through the selection process.  
 Recruitment agencies: our Talent Acquisition team recruits directly and will contact selected partners if external support is required.
